name: Worgen in the Woods
label: Quest
description: Calor sends you to Darkshire with a letter for Jonathan Carevin after your hunts against the worgen in Duskwood. Carevin faces dangers beyond the beasts…

clips.title: The story
paras: Calor sends you to Darkshire with a letter for Jonathan Carevin after your hunts against the worgen in Duskwood. Carevin faces dangers beyond the beasts, and Calor believes your skill can aid him.

You have driven the Nightbane pack from Roland's Doom and the shadowed glades, earning Calor's respect. He is stationed on the dark frontier of the woods and rarely offers praise or formal introductions. Calor gives you a faded scrap of parchment and asks you to deliver his recommendation to Jonathan Carevin in Darkshire. He says that with more fighters like you, his small company might outshine the town's beleaguered Night Watch.

Jonathan Carevin works in Darkshire under heavy strain, wary of outsiders and short on time. The town faces worgen, restless undead, demonic forces, and cultists aiding the corruption from within. Calor's recommendation wins Carevin's trust, and he sees you as a dependable fighter ready to preserve the Light against Duskwood's terrors.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here you go, friend. Bring this message to Master Carevin.
He quickly removes a piece of faded parchment and offers it to you.
A few more like you, and we will outnumber the Night Watch! Perhaps then we could complete the work that we few carry on today.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes, what is it? Make it quick, I've pressing matters to attend to.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excuse me for my cold reception, friend, but as I'm sure you can tell, I am an extremely busy man. I see that you have impressed Calor--and I assure you, that is no small feat—and that he has given his recommendation.

There are unsavory types afoot, friend, and we can use the help of all who have proven themselves. We battle against demons, the undead, and those who would provide them aid. Be vigilant, be wary, and trust none who would not give aid to our cause.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
